description: This file contains a PHP class definition for the 'Cod' payment extension in the OpenCart e-commerce platform. It defines the 'Cod' class with methods for handling payments via Cash on Delivery, including methods for displaying the payment option and confirming orders.

classes.name: Cod
classes.description: A controller class for handling 'Cash on Delivery' payment method, extending the core system controller in OpenCart. It includes methods for rendering the payment option and confirming the order.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Displays the COD payment option view to the customer.

methods.name: confirm
methods.description: Processes the confirmation of a COD payment, updating the order status and returning a JSON response.
